articles.summary: Affirms that HSA is fully current on rent Medical Properties Trust, Inc. (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today issued the following statement regarding litigation involving Healthcare Systems of America (“HSA"). “We are aware that the principals of HSA are currently engaged in litigation in which MPT is not involved. Separately, we have sent certain ordinary course legal notices to HSA intended to protect our legal interests. We do not expect this situation to impact rent collections moving
articles.title: Medical Properties Trust Issues Statement on Healthcare Systems of America
